blockers.detail: Pinned frontend emits C; CMO-REG-1 is not integrated into class calls or the allocator.
Arbitrary template instantiation is not supported by the pinned frontend; typed containers are adapted APIs.
The supplied 174-module snapshot is only partially ported. Remaining implementable modules and permitted OS services are documented.
Windows/macOS libraries cross-built and audited; compiled core replay runs in six CPU modes with a simulated allocator. Native Windows/macOS/ARM host tests remain required.
Tracked ownership and concurrency tests pass, but LSan inspection is unavailable and a ThreadSanitizer pass is not claimed.

cross_execution: six compiled-core CPU modes, simulated allocator; not native OS
